information: ## THERE IS STRICTLY NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR BEVERAGES ALLOWED IN THE VENUE. ### ALL MINORS IN THE VENUE MUST BE SUPERVISED BY AN ADULT. This competition takes place in the Hickory rooms, located inside the main building of the The Ohioan Hotel & Event Center campus. There is additional spectator seating available in the Cypress room.
